# Vendored component: ComfyUI UI → API workflow converter

Source package: `comfyui-mcp@0.52.206`
Upstream: https://github.com/artokun/comfyui-mcp
License: MIT (see LICENSE in this directory)

Only the self-contained converter closure is vendored here:

- `services/workflow-converter.js`
- `services/flatten-workflow.js`
- `utils/logger.js`
- `comfyui/loader-asset-inputs.js`

The files are unmodified build outputs. `SHA256SUMS` records their hashes.
The rest of the package (including native dependencies and unrelated tools)
is deliberately not included.
